recoveredFacts: Owner preprocessor adds selected skill mana_init to talent 2 mana_init and copies selected skill mana_max into talent 1.
Dummy talent component 5732173963253464043 stores mana with a one-second period, mana_add increment and mana_max cap.
marcil_t imports stored mana on owner birth and exports current SP to the shared mana key on owner finish unless clearSp is set.
S1 and S2 main chants are not suspendable; S3 main chant is not suspendable and its extra chant is suspendable.
S1 spends sp_cost on output attack or heal; S2 spends skill_cost_min_sp on buff late enable.
S3 extended-chant finish sets clearSp when the owner is no longer alive.
Talent 2 selects laios-tagged squad cards with minCntToTrig 4.
holdReasons: Complete ordinary combat, mana persistence and recovery, chanting, both talents, all skills, terrain effects and public lifecycle require review
